name: io.github.crane-valley/framedash-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Framedash game telemetry: query analytics, heatmaps, perf regressions, and alerts

environmentVariables.name: FRAMEDASH_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Framedash API key. Create one on your project's API Keys page at https://app.framedash.dev.

environmentVariables.name: FRAMEDASH_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default project id. When unset, project-scoped tools require a project_id argument.

environmentVariables.name: FRAMEDASH_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://app.framedash.dev.
